info.name: WorkWell Technologies API (uAttend) Punch Reports Timecards API
Retrieve timecard data for a user and pay period

items.docs: Returns the timecard for a specified user. If no date is provided, the current pay period is returned. If a date is supplied, the timecard covering that date is returned. All time durations are strings in HH:mm format; dates are yyyy-mm-dd; punch times are 12-hour strings.
